profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Full-stack software engineer specializing in microservices architecture, exploring AI/ML solutions, and ROSA/cloud-native deployed applications. Currently building insurance technology at State Farm that serves thousands of customers daily.

Proven track record of:
- Modernizing legacy systems with React, Spring Boot, and AWS
- Building enterprise-scale applications for Fortune 500 companies
- Leading cross-functional teams and mentoring junior engineers
- Driving DevOps excellence with CI/CD automation

Currently exploring: LLM engineering, RAG systems, AI agents, and agentic workflows using Python, LangChain, and vector databases.

Always seeking opportunities to work on meaningful projects that make a real impact.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building scalable insurance technology solutions:

- Implemented enhancements to homeowners insurance quote service using Spring Boot microservices, orchestrating communication between multiple services to deliver accurate coverage and transparent pricing for thousands of customers

- Spearheaded legacy application modernization using React and Spring Boot on AWS, dramatically improving data retrieval speed and accuracy for hundreds of internal users

- Reduced claim processing time and decreased support tickets by implementing WalkMe workflow automations, streamlining the claims handler experience

Tech Stack: Spring Boot, React, AWS, Microservices, REST APIs, WalkMe

positions.title: Full Stack Software Developer
positions.description:
Drove cloud transformation and DevOps excellence for enterprise-scale operations:

- Built enterprise Angular + Spring Boot application that simplified cloud migration approvals for all technology teams, accelerating digital transformation initiatives

- Designed proof-of-concept infrastructure pipeline using Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure Pipelines, establishing streamlined cloud provisioning standards for enterprise teams

- Owned end-to-end documentation in Docusaurus for developer onboarding and user adoption

- Enhanced CI/CD pipeline as code with PowerShell and Azure DevOps, achieving sub-1-hour deployments with integrated vulnerability scanning, quality gates, and automated testing

- Reduced sprint planning overhead by developing internal Planning Poker application in Angular and Node.js

- Maintained uptime for business-critical APIs on IBM API Connect platform

- Led and mentored team of 5 junior engineers, providing technical guidance and operational support

- Automated tenant data migration for IBM API Connect platform using custom PowerShell scripts, completing in minutes what previously took hours

Tech Stack: Angular, Spring Boot, Docker, Kubernetes, Azure DevOps, PowerShell, Node.js, IBM API Connect
